bifrost: springboard/src/net/share.rs (Service, Peers, beacon, transfer), springboard/src/shell/share/glue.rs, springboard/sdk/src/share.rs
summary: BifrOSt has nearby LAN discovery and one-shot file and byte transfer between devices, run by the shell (UDP beacon on 224.0.0.251:5354, TCP transfer with an explicit Accept). Apps get no SDK API for peers, sessions, invitations or messages, and nothing is encrypted in transit; the MultipeerConnectivity session model is not covered.

features.note: The service type rules and the browse state are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-os-04.rs. Gap: there is no found or lost peer delegate, and the shell's beacon does not yet browse an app's service type.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 4 tests. Wave 5 (w5-multipeer-connectivity, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The beacon carries a device name, a TCP port and a fingerprint of the shared secret. It is not per-app and apps cannot publish their own service. round 75, host only: SDK path; not wired into the shell.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/share/mod.rs (Send Nearby list), springboard/src/shell/share/prompt.rs (Accept/Decline banner); springboard/src/shell/share/mod.rs, prompt.rs, progress.rs
features.note: The shell draws a Nearby device row and an incoming-offer prompt. No app can present the peer picker or receive the invitation decision. round 75, host only: shell progress card; no app peer picker.
A peer is a display name plus a socket address that changes with the network. There is no stable peer ID object an app can hold.

features.feature: Sessions and invitations (MCSession, invite and accept)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 10 tests. Wave 3 (theme-21, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Only a one-file Offer exists, answered by the user. There is no session object, no multi-peer connection state, and no connected or disconnected callbacks.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 10 tests. Wave 3 (theme-21, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. send_bytes sends a one-shot named payload from the shell. Apps have no send API and no reliable or unreliable mode.

File transfer works between BifrOSt devices with a size limit, a SHA-256 check and a receive deadline. There is no streaming API, no progress for apps (the shell passes a no-op progress callback), and apps cannot start it.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 5 (theme-09, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The header carries an HMAC keyed by the secret, and the body is streamed in plaintext. No TLS or session encryption exists. The default secret is the constant "nearby". round 75, host only: body still plaintext.

features.feature: Background behaviour (stop and resume on background)
features.apple: framework stops advertising and browsing when the app is backgrounded
features.note: The browse is suspended in the background and resumes in the foreground, tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-os-04.rs. Gap: the shell's beacon does not take this state yet, so it keeps running while the desktop is up.

Every share failure is a typed ShareError with a fixed domain (net.share), stable codes, an io kind and a display message, tested headless. Gap: apps do not receive these errors yet because the SDK has no share API, and the wire carries no code.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 10 tests. Wave 3 (theme-21, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No session exists, so there is no peer limit.

gaps: Peer sessions exist in the SDK (sdk peer_session.rs, named listeners and endpoints), but an app cannot browse or advertise its own service type or list nearby peers (springboard/sdk/src/share.rs exposes only show_picker and is_inbound).
No invitation flow and no multi-peer session object; the connection model is in peer_session.rs (Hub connect and accept, SessionId).
No app-facing message or resource send, and no streaming, so apps cannot exchange data with nearby peers.
No encryption in transit (body plaintext, HMAC over the header only) and a constant default secret "nearby".
No stable peer identity (MCPeerID); peers are a name and an address that changes.
The SDK share picker lists apps that accept the items and Copy, not the Send Nearby device list (per docs/bifrost-ui.md, Share sheet section).
